availability_note: Same Route 133 sail-lane party (gate<=68 pool-84 entries; Landorus and Tapu Fini are reachable legends). Nothing from Underwater/Seafloor maps.

strategy_checks.check: Musharna sets Trick Room turn 1 (or Helping Hands Golem)
strategy_checks.evidence: T1 Musharna chose Trick Room; Urshifu's Wicked Blow (crit, 2x) OHKOed it from 363 HP before it moved.

strategy_checks.check: Galvanize Double-Edge used as the Electric attack
strategy_checks.evidence: T1 Golem-Alola Double-Edge into Urshifu for 192 with Life Orb + recoil messages; T2 it chose Double-Edge again but was KOed first.

strategy_checks.check: Cofagrigus is the backup setter for the second half
strategy_checks.evidence: T3 Cofagrigus chose Trick Room on entry; OHKOed by Wicked Blow (2x crit) first. Mummy correctly replaced Urshifu's Unseen Fist on contact.

strategy_checks.check: Mega Drampa fires Hyper Voice/Draco Meteor under a room
strategy_checks.evidence: Both setters died before acting; Drampa Mega Evolved on T6, Protected, then died to Close Combat + Moonblast without attacking. Berserk did trigger (Sp. Atk rose) on the Close Combat hit.

strategy_checks.check: Slow bodies attack with Rock Slide / High Horsepower / Wood Hammer
strategy_checks.evidence: T3 Torterra High Horsepower into Incineroar (211, 2x); T4 Aggron Rock Slide KOed Incineroar; T5 Torterra chose Wood Hammer.

protect_ledger.payoff: REAL - blocked Incineroar's Flare Blitz (2x); partner Golem still died to Close Combat.
REAL (consecutive-Protect gamble succeeded) - blocked a second lethal Flare Blitz while Aggron's Rock Slide KOed Incineroar. Strong turn.
PARTIAL - blocked Muddy Water and survived the turn, but Torterra died beside it and Aggron then died before acting on T6. Delayed rather than converted.
EMPTY-ISH - blocked a 2x Moonblast, but as the last Pokémon with no partner it only postponed the same two attacks by a turn.

engine_notes.note: 'The opposing Golem couldn't fully protect itself' printed when Close Combat (Unseen Fist) hit a Golem that had chosen Double-Edge; same cosmetic Unseen Fist message seen in E0438.

level_changes.why: Won first try with one faint. The room never went up: Musharna was OHKOed by one Wicked Blow before its T1 Trick Room. The whole six-member concept depends on one setter surviving one hit.
Backup setter also OHKOed on entry before its Trick Room resolved. +1 to both setters is the level-only way to give the room a chance; the Mega and attackers are untouched.

level_changes_unverified: Cannot be re-verified until the main agent rebuilds the headless ROM; attempt 1 was played at setters L83.
cooler: The structure (two setters, zero-Speed IVs, Mega finisher) is right and the Torterra double-Protect turn was the AI at its best. The concept fails to fire against a Dark crit attacker because both setters have 4 Def EVs and die to one physical hit; a Sitrus/Colbur or a Def-invested spread (not this pass) would matter more than any species change. Nothing is over-represented.
authored_set_legality: No problem; all six sets played as written, Mega Drampa evolved on T6, Berserk fired.
